title: Manufacturing & Industrial
lead: Custom-built digital platforms for manufacturing workflows, automation, and real-time operational control.
challenges: Critical equipment drifting toward failure without warning
Manual checks and delayed feedback causing unplanned downtime
Plant intelligence locked inside control rooms and desktops
capabilities: Predictive maintenance and equipment-life forecasting
Real-time sensor analytics and anomaly detection
Spatially mapped, animated plant-floor dashboards
Mobile companion apps with live alerts over WebSockets

title: Logistics & Transportation
lead: Digital freight platforms that match loads to trucks, keep every trip visible and settle payments only when delivery is proven.
challenges: Loads matched to trucks over phone calls and middlemen
No live view of a truck once it leaves the yard
Payment disputes over what was delivered, and when
capabilities: Load marketplaces with instant accept or reverse-auction bidding
Driver apps with live GPS tracking and route maps
OTP-verified proof of delivery
Escrow-style payments with automatic carrier payouts

title: Smart Home & IoT
lead: Local-first home automation that fits the wiring people already have, from the board behind the switch to the app in their hand.
challenges: Smart devices that stop working when the internet drops
Retrofits that mean replacing every switch
No clear picture of where the electricity goes
capabilities: ESP32-based boards that mesh over their own Wi-Fi
Room-by-room control of lights, fans, ACs, sockets and locks
Live energy monitoring with limits and alerts
Guided, secure device setup

title: Food & Consumer
lead: Ordering, commerce and traceability platforms for canteens, food brands and the people they feed.
challenges: Peak-hour queues at canteens and food counters
Shoppers who can't tell where a pack came from
Small vendors without the tools to see their own sales
capabilities: Order-ahead apps with in-app UPI payments and pickup tokens
Vendor dashboards with live order queues and sales exports
QR traceability for every pack
Direct-to-home commerce apps for food brands

title: Agriculture & AgriTech
lead: Technology-driven agricultural platforms for monitoring, optimization, and data-led farming operations under one ecosystem.
challenges: Fragmented tooling across sowing, irrigation, harvesting and reaping
Disconnected logistics, cold storage and distribution
capabilities: Multi-functional field robotics concepts
Soil, moisture and nutrient sensing
A central console linking farmers, vendors, storage and distributors
Data-led planning for yield and supply

title: Technology & Engineering Services
lead: End-to-end software, AI and infrastructure engineering for teams that need dependable delivery.
challenges: Ideas that need a production-grade system, not a prototype
Legacy workflows that don't talk to each other
Apps that must stay online and observable after launch
capabilities: Full stack web development with clean system architecture
AI and ML engineering, from data to deployed model
Mobile and web app development, hosting and monitoring
Custom high-performance PC and workstation builds
